activity_additions.name: Tetracompass pieces → ancient caskets → complete tomes
activity_additions.location: Piece drops / collection hand-ins at multi-region dig sites; restore + power at Archaeology Campus mysterious monolith; dig ancient casket at compass tip; study complete tomes at Guild upstairs desk
requirements: 50 Archaeology to restore tetracompass (unpowered) and to excavate the ancient-casket dig location pointed by a powered tetracompass
Four ordered pieces: left → right → dial → needle (excavation rare drops, guaranteed from listed collection repeats, or Mr Mordaut research Treasure Hoarder / 24h expedition guarantee)
Restore costs: 30 malachite green + 30 cadmium red + 30 cobalt blue + 30 Armadylean yellow + 30 Tyrian purple + the four pieces
Ironman self-source of malachite green and Armadylean yellow requires 76 Archaeology (boostable) — Warforge / Stormguard material access
Power unpowered tetracompass at the mysterious monolith (970 Archaeology XP each; up to ten at a time)
Complete tomes studied only at the study desk upstairs in the Archaeology Guild (base Archaeology level only — boosts do not raise tome XP)
unlocks: Account progression loop: tetracompass pieces → tetracompass (unpowered) → tetracompass (powered) → ancient casket dig
Ancient casket rolls: 3–5 damaged artefacts, materials, Archaeology supplies, 1–2 complete tomes, elite or master clue, and rare dragon mattock (1%) / shadowy key (Guildmaster Tony's mattock path)
Complete tome: large Archaeology XP by base level when studied at Guild desk (e.g. wiki table 45,002 XP at 99; 86,561 XP at 120) — cannot bank tomes
Collection-repeat piece sources include Urns of the Empire (67), Green Gobbo Goodies I–III, Red Rum Relics I–III, Saradominist II–IV, Zamorakian II–IV, Guthixian I–II, Dragonkin VII
Overflow casket loot reclaimable from ancient casket scenery next to research desk if backpack/bank full (tomes stay in Guild casket until reclaim)
region_pressure: Misthalin hard-owns monolith powering, Guild study desk for complete tomes, and casket reclaim scenery — the loop endpoint is starting-region campus.
Kandarin optional: Warforge Green Gobbo / Red Rum piece farms and malachite green / Armadylean yellow ironman material gate at 76.
Desert / Morytania / Forinthry / Anachronia / Havenhythe optional: other piece-reward collections and general excavation rare drops at their dig sites.
Tier-2+ luck (Luck of the Dwarves) increases chance of tetracompass pieces and complete tomes while excavating — link cross-region:luck-of-the-dwarves.
activity_additions.notes: Wave-5 rank 7 first-class row. Not a dig-site hub and not a training XP/hour claim — permanent material-sink → XP/loot progression infrastructure. Complements dig-site hubs and misthalin:guildmaster-tonys-mattock (shadowy key) without re-emitting those ids. Do not invent piece rates or casket averages beyond wiki structure.
activity_additions.league_treatment: Misthalin required for power + tome study + reclaim. Piece farming and colour materials pressure elective dig-site regions (especially Kandarin Warforge for efficient ironman piece loops).

activity_additions.name: Soil box + material storage capacity ladders
activity_additions.location: Archaeological soil box from Ezreal (tutorial / Guild shop reclaim); material storage containers at Archaeology Campus, all dig sites, Fort Forinthry Workshop, and Memorial to Guthix (quest-only)
requirements: Archaeology tutorial / free soil box claim from Ezreal (one owned; free reclaim retains upgrades and stored soil)
Soil box capacity upgrades from Archaeology Guild Shop by qualification: Intern free 50 each soil; Assistant 3,500 chronotes → 100; Associate 18,000 → 250; Professor 48,000 → 500
Material storage type-capacity upgrades from same shop: Intern free 30 material types; Assistant 7,000 chronotes → 35; Associate 25,000 → 40; Professor 60,000 → 45
Qualifications (Intern → Assistant → Associate → Professor) gate which upgrades appear — chronotes from collectors / dig sites
unlocks: Archaeological soil box: holds up to capacity of each soil type; fill/inspect without interrupting excavation; screen soil directly from the box; deposit contents via bank/deposit box
Soil box capacity ladder 50 → 100 → 250 → 500 of each soil (permanent account upgrades; auto-screener can make late soil-box ranks optional depending on loadout)
Material storage container: shared capacity across campus / dig-site / Fort containers; holds Archaeology restoration materials by type
Material storage type ladder 30 → 35 → 40 → 45 types (base raised to 30 on 15 June 2026 wiki; full late-game material sets need Professor upgrade)
Signs of the porter / Grace of the Elves send excavated materials straight into material storage; materials carts bank overflow when type slots full
region_pressure: Misthalin hard-owns Guild shop upgrades, tutorial soil box, and campus material storage.
Dig-site containers exist in every Archaeology region once those sites unlock — capacity upgrades still purchase only at Misthalin Guild.
Fort Forinthry Workshop container is Forinthry convenience only after Workshop build — not a second upgrade shop.
activity_additions.notes: Wave-5 rank 16. Parity row with asgarnia:ore-box-tier-upgrades and misthalin:wood-box-tier-upgrades — Archaeology's two permanent capacity ladders bundled (soil quantity + material type slots). Complements misthalin:auto-screener and misthalin:archaeology-guild-shop without re-emitting those ids. Do not invent soil XP rates.
activity_additions.league_treatment: Hard Misthalin for shop capacity purchases. Dig-site use of containers follows whichever dig-site regions are unlocked.

activity_additions.name: Archaeologist's tea (Guild shop excavation XP boost)
requirements: Qualification - Intern for Archaeology Guild Shop stock of archaeologist's tea
2,000 chronotes per cup from Ezreal (infinite stock)
Also obtainable: ancient casket (1/4), pickpocketing trainee archaeologists / archaeologists / archaeology professors, and Reiniger qualification claim packs (includes tea)
unlocks: Permanent shop access to archaeologist's tea after Intern qualification
Drink: +50% Archaeology excavation XP for 20 minutes (30 minutes with full master archaeologist's outfit); also +50% equipment XP on an augmented mattock
Duration stacks by drinking multiple cups up to 60 minutes total (warning if a drink would exceed the hour cap)
Tea is destroyed on drink; not a permanent passive — same consumable-shop class as material manuals
region_pressure: Misthalin hard-owns Guild shop purchase and Reiniger claim path.
Chronotes and casket/pickpocket tea supply still pressure multi-region dig sites — shop access itself is Misthalin.
activity_additions.notes: Wave-5 rank 15. Real permanent shop unlock + ironman 1–99 excavation XP consumable path. Not Cup of soil tea (level boost). Complements misthalin:material-manuals (same shop boost family) and misthalin:master-archaeologists-outfit (duration extension) without re-emitting those ids. Not a permanent account passive — model as shop infrastructure.
activity_additions.league_treatment: Hard Misthalin for shop access after Intern. Excavation use is global once stocked.

activity_additions.name: Luck of the Dwarves (Archaeology rare-table / tetra / tome luck)
activity_additions.category: skilling luck ring + Archaeology rare-drop QoL
activity_additions.location: Craft anywhere with furnace + ring mould after alchemical onyx; dwarf tele package centres on Keldagrim / Miscellania (Fremennik); Invention alchemical onyx at inventor's workbench (Asgarnia Guild natural hub)
requirements: 107 Invention to discover and manufacture alchemical onyx (onyx + 50 fortunate + 50 refined + 10 precious components) at an inventor's workbench
91 Crafting: alchemical onyx + gold bar → alchemical onyx ring
87 Magic: Lvl-6 Enchant on alchemical onyx ring → Luck of the Dwarves (tier-4 luck; includes tier 1–3 effects)
Keldagrim first-entry cutscene for Keldagrim teleport; Throne of Miscellania for Miscellania teleport
Optional: Hand of glory (dig-site Archaeology artefacts) + LotD → Luck of the Dwarves monolith relic power (passive luck without wearing the ring)
Optional: Dark Facet of Luck for clue-step skip / double casket rolls + Dwarven Outpost teleport
unlocks: Tier-4 luck enhancer worn (or harnessed as Archaeology monolith relic power after Hand of glory conversion)
Archaeology skilling luck: improved chance of finding a tetracompass piece or complete tome while excavating
Broader skilling luck also covers metamorphic geodes, Pyramid Plunder rares, implings, Seren's symbol pieces, clue-while-skilling, etc. — this row prioritises Arch rare-table framing
Unlimited teleports: Miscellania (quest-gated), Grand Exchange (Varrock), Keldagrim (first-entry), plus Dwarven Outpost with Dark Facet
Ring can be equipped at kill moment for combat rare tables — combat BiS comparison is out of scope here
region_pressure: Fremennik hard-owns dwarf-ring teleport identity (Keldagrim + Miscellania path) and namesake luck-ring geography.
Asgarnia hard-owns practical Invention Guild / inventor's workbench path for alchemical onyx manufacture on ironman.
Misthalin optional: GE teleport convenience + mysterious monolith harness if converting LotD into the Archaeology relic power via Hand of glory.
activity_additions.notes: Wave-5 rank 6 under suggested id cross-region:luck-of-the-dwarves (not fremennik:luck-of-the-dwarves alone — craft/Invention pressure is multi-region).
